fields.title: Office Network Outage
fields.description: Entire office on Floor 1 unable to connect to the network. All workstations affected.
fields.escalation_reason: Unresolved after 48 hours, escalated to HOD

fields.title: Server Temperature Alert
fields.description: Critical temperature alert triggered in Data Center. Server room temperature exceeding safe threshold.
fields.escalation_reason: Temperature risk escalated to HOD. Cooling system failure.
fields.pending_comment: Cooling unit repair requires specialist HVAC vendor. Server room maintained at safe temperature via temporary portable cooling unit. Vendor appointment scheduled.

fields.title: Leaking Faucet
fields.description: Kitchen sink faucet in Cafeteria has continuous drip. Water wastage is significant.

fields.title: Network Port Damage
fields.description: Wall network port in Conference Room B physically damaged, likely from accidental impact.

fields.title: AC Unit Malfunction
fields.description: HVAC unit in West Wing not providing cooling. Room temperature uncomfortably high.

fields.title: Oven Element Burnout
fields.description: Cafeteria primary oven heating element not working. Baking operations affected.
fields.pending_comment: Oven heating element ordered from supplier, expected delivery Friday. Cafeteria operations temporarily using secondary stove for baking.

fields.title: Slow Internet Speed
fields.description: Internet connection running at approximately half the contracted speed. Confirmed on multiple devices.

fields.title: Blocked Drainage
fields.description: Laundry room main drain backing up. Standing water accumulating, creating slip hazard.
fields.escalation_reason: Slip hazard unresolved after 24 hours, escalated to section head

fields.title: Damaged Power Outlet
fields.description: Power outlet casing near water cooler broken and exposed. Potential electrical safety hazard.

fields.title: Software License Expiring
fields.description: Project management software license expires in 7 days. Renewal or replacement required urgently.

fields.title: Door Lock Sticky
fields.description: Apartment 101 entrance door lock very difficult to turn. Residents struggling to access unit.

fields.title: Cold Draft in Conference Room
fields.description: Cold air draft entering from window frames in Conference Room B. Heating costs affected.

fields.title: Database Backup Failed
fields.description: Automated nightly database backup failed with error code 500. Last successful backup was 36 hours ago.
fields.escalation_reason: Critical system backup failure escalated to section head

fields.title: Broken Training Room Shelf
fields.description: Library cabinet shelf in training room collapsed under weight. Shelf must be replaced before next session.

fields.title: Refrigerator Malfunction
fields.description: Main cafeteria refrigerator not maintaining safe storage temperature. Food safety concern.

fields.title: Fire Alarm False Trigger
fields.description: Fire alarm triggered twice without any actual fire. Causing unnecessary evacuations and disruption.

fields.title: Wi-Fi Dead Zone
fields.description: No Wi-Fi signal in the south corner of Conference Room B. Affects meetings and presentations.
fields.pending_comment: Access point ordered from supplier. Estimated delivery 3-5 business days. Affected area has partial coverage via neighbouring access point.

fields.title: Treadmill Belt Slipping
fields.description: Staff gym treadmill belt slipping under load. Equipment unsafe to use until repaired.

fields.title: Water Heater Leaking
fields.description: Water heater in Apartment 205 leaking from the base. Risk of water damage to flooring below.

fields.title: Projector Display Issues
fields.description: Conference Room B projector showing distorted colours and horizontal lines across the image.

fields.title: Electrical Panel Noise
fields.description: Electrical distribution panel in Main Office Block producing unusual buzzing sound. Potential fault.
fields.location_details: Ground Floor, Main Distribution Board Room

fields.title: Dishwasher Not Draining
fields.description: Industrial dishwasher in cafeteria not completing drain cycle. Standing water remaining in drum.

fields.title: HVAC Making Noise
fields.description: Data Center HVAC unit producing loud rattling noise during operation. May indicate loose component.

fields.title: Loose Door Handle
fields.description: Main entrance door handle loose and wobbles. Needs tightening before it detaches completely.

fields.title: Printer Offline
fields.description: Network printer in Main Office Block keeps dropping offline every few hours. Multiple users affected.
fields.pending_comment: Replacement network interface card ordered. Estimated arrival 2-3 business days. Users directed to use alternate printer on Floor 2.

fields.title: Projector Not Working
fields.description: Classroom projector displaying no image. Power light on but no signal output to screen.

fields.title: Whiteboard Markers Dried Out
fields.description: All whiteboard markers in Training Room 2 dried out and unusable. Session starting Monday.

fields.title: Sound System Feedback
fields.description: Audio feedback (high-pitched squeal) from classroom sound system when microphone is used. Disrupting training.
fields.escalation_reason: Sound feedback persisting across multiple classrooms, escalated to section head

fields.title: Faulty Desk Lamp
fields.description: Instructor desk lamp in Training Room 1 flickering intermittently. Eye strain concern for long sessions.

fields.title: Training Room Door Lock Malfunction
fields.description: Training Room 3 door lock not engaging properly. Door swings open during sessions.

fields.title: Interview Room Booking System Down
fields.description: Interview room scheduling system inaccessible from intranet. Manual booking in place as workaround.

fields.title: Office Furniture Delivery
fields.description: New ergonomic office furniture delivery and setup required. Staff awaiting chairs and standing desks.
fields.pending_comment: Furniture vendor has confirmed order dispatch but awaiting final delivery schedule confirmation. Installation team on standby once delivery date confirmed.

fields.title: Office Supply Cabinet Key Lost
fields.description: Key to main office supply cabinet has been misplaced. Cabinet is locked and contents inaccessible.

fields.title: Printer Refill Required
fields.description: HR office printer out of ink and paper. Printing for recruitment documentation halted.

fields.text: Reviewed cabling in server room. Main switch unresponsive — rebooting and monitoring for re-occurrence.
Switch came back online but dropped again after 2 hours. Suspect faulty SFP module in the core switch. Ordered replacement.
Portable cooling unit deployed. Server room temperature now at 22°C. Monitoring every 30 minutes until HVAC vendor arrives.
The faucet is still dripping badly. Water pooling on the floor. Please prioritise.
Disassembled tap, replaced worn washer and O-ring. Faucet tested for 30 minutes — no further dripping.
Used drain snake — partial clearance achieved. Blockage is deep in the main pipe. Will need drain jetting equipment.
Identified faulty ionisation smoke detector on Floor 2 East. Replaced sensor unit and recalibrated panel. False triggers eliminated.

fields.comment: Faucet fixed properly and quickly. John was very professional.
Internet speed back to full capacity. Root cause identified and fixed cleanly.
Lock is working now. Took slightly longer than expected but job was done properly.
Excellent response to a safety-critical issue. Resolved same day and verified working.
Heater fully repaired and tested thoroughly before handover. No further leaks. Very satisfied.
